1.consolidated_definition: alim. Postre preparado con helado, sirope y pedazos de dulce puestos sobre un guineo maduro. Anglicismo crudo, usual. Banana split, ingredientes: 1 plátano, 3 bolas de helado de distintos sabores; salsa de chocolate, caramelo y fresa; coco rallado, sprinkles o trocitos de chocolate, pistachos, nata en spray y guindas
1.en_consolidated_definition: Dessert prepared with ice cream, syrup, and pieces of sweet placed on a ripe banana. Raw anglicism, common. Banana split, ingredients: 1 banana, 3 scoops of ice cream in different flavors; chocolate sauce, caramel, and strawberry sauce; shredded coconut, sprinkles or chocolate chips, pistachios, whipped cream, and maraschino cherries
